rule: Every gate at the candidate is listed with its Q-IDs, every CI entrypoint and every check it reaches is listed, and every deletion, count decrease, skip increase, missing test name and workflow change between each base tree and the candidate tree is guarded by a selector into the candidate's own files (an assertion line or a test body digest, never a title alone), preserved as original bytes outside the public tree (recorded as preservation, not as protection), retired with an in-tree basis and the assertion that guards the remainder, or reclassified with an in-tree basis. Mixed findings are split into components whose deltas must add up to the finding; the commits named in deltas are explanatory.

dispositions.guarded: (a) the candidate's own file or entrypoint carries the protection; selectors are verified at the candidate and at least one is an assertion line or a body digest
dispositions.preserved: (b) only an internal record was affected; its original bytes are pinned in git history and kept in the local preservation root whose basis document is pinned by sha256; not counted as protection
dispositions.retired: (c) the responsibility ended; basis lines at the candidate and the assertion that guards the remainder are recorded, or an unguarded_reason when nothing guards it
dispositions.reclassified: the finding is not a weakening; basis lines at the candidate are recorded

local_runners.invoked_by: local evidence runner outside the public tree; named in the preservation basis document
